pr.title: Fix search treating % and _ as wildcards

lenses.note: Bug fix with a narrow scope. The diff does what the PR says and adds nothing else. The only choice is that `\` is also literal, and the PR states it.
No spec file in the change.

The new tests insert titles with %, _ and \ and assert exact result lists. They would fail without the escaping, for example `?q=%25` would list every item. I could not run them: vitest is not installed here, so `npm test` failed with 'vitest: not found'. CI runs them.
The diff touches no docs files, and no behaviour documented elsewhere changed.
The escape regex covers \, % and _. The ESCAPE '\\' in the JS string becomes ESCAPE '\' in SQL, which is a valid single-character escape. The value is still bound as a parameter.
The query stays parameterised. The change removes unintended wildcard matching and adds no injection surface.
The diff touches no UI files.
The diff touches no UI files.
The title is under 72 characters. The claims match the diff: ESCAPE added, the three characters escaped, a test added, no tests deleted.
